title: "Inference-Serving Kernels"
---

# Inference-Serving Kernels
LLM inference splits into two distinct execution regimes with radically different performance characteristics:
1. **Prefill Phase:** The prompt is processed in parallel. High operational intensity, strictly compute-bound.
2. **Decode Phase:** Tokens are generated autoregressively one by one. The model loads billions of weights to compute a single new vector. Strictly memory-bound!

### PagedAttention (vLLM)

In standard inference, KV caches must be allocated as contiguous memory buffers. This leads to 60-80% memory waste due to internal and external memory fragmentation.
PagedAttention treats KV cache memory like virtual memory pages in an operating system:
- KV vectors are stored in non-contiguous 16-token page blocks.
- A page table maps logical token positions to physical GPU memory addresses.
- Result: Memory waste drops to near 0%, enabling 2-4x higher serving concurrency on the same hardware.
